hooks.name: Auto Commit and Push on Turn End
hooks.description: After an agent turn completes, stage all changes, commit with a timestamped message, and push to the current branch's origin. Bundles source and generated test changes into one commit.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && git add -A && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore: auto-commit ($(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))") && git push origin "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
